acquisition.dataset: LANL User-Computer Authentication Associations in Time (2014 release)
acquisition.license: LANL waiver of copyright and related or neighboring rights
acquisition.monthly_slice_description: Second published 30-day file; actual calendar dates undisclosed
acquisition.deadline_semantics: Deadline checked before each read; an outstanding read has a maximum ten-second socket timeout; local parsing is separate

protocol.selection: Second monthly file, fixed first 16 MiB prefix, chosen before acquisition or outcomes
protocol.tail: Discard every row at the final observed timestamp
protocol.relative_time: Original release-relative seconds; never shifted to a calendar epoch

labels.eligibility_reason: Successful authentication alone does not establish legitimate intent; source provides no attack labels

limitations: Additional time slice from the same institution and release; not an independent organization or third independent dataset.
Actual collection dates and identity overlap with other releases are undisclosed.
Only a bounded file prefix is acquired, not the full 30-day slice or nine-month release.
Successful-only events have no attack labels and are not a benign training guarantee.
Full-archive SHA-256 and final bzip2 CRC/trailer are not verified; decoder still validates available blocks.
Acquisition statistics alone are not a learned-model evaluation or deployment recommendation.
